todo: All onboarding copy must be read by a clinical partner before real use. The framing of the track fork in particular decides who self-identifies as 'in recovery', and getting the wording wrong pushes people into the wrong track.

steps.title: What this is
body: This app is about one thing: the odds you cannot see.
It holds a handful of tools that work with no signal, no account and no internet, and a list of Singapore helplines that are one tap away from every screen.

steps.title: What this isn't
body: It is not medical advice, not counselling, and not a substitute for a person.
It is not run by, checked by, or connected to any government agency or charity.
Nobody is on the other end of this app. If you need someone right now, use the red button. It works offline, from any screen.

steps.title: Which one is you, today?
body: These are two different apps with two different jobs. Pick the one that fits. You can switch later in Settings.

options.label: I want to stay informed
options.detail: Understand what's actually going around, and practise getting out of a moment you don't want to be in.

options.label: I'm in recovery
options.detail: Tools for right now — urges, cravings, pressure, and a fast way out of a room.
